text:
Nila: dropping a new mock for a slim compare mode — idea: compact cards on mobile, optional dense table on desktop. Quick Qs: filters UX (rail vs modal), how to make version pin discoverable, and badge copy/contrast. screenshot: <link>
Marco: I like compact cards for phones. Desktop should default to table but allow an obvious toggle in the header. Persist toggle per-user.
Priya: Filters: rail on desktop, modal on mobile. Always show active filters as chips inline with the search bar so state is visible without opening anything.
Vik: Pin discoverability is weak. Make the pin a slightly larger tappable area and add an explicit "Pin version" action in the item overflow menu. Also support a left checkbox to enable multi-select compare flows.
A11yBot: Accessibility notes: badges fail contrast (current green text on light green bg). Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. Add aria-labels to badges e.g. "Throughput p50: 145 rps". Icons need sr-only text.
Nila: Good call. Also microcopy: change "Perf: 145" to "Throughput (p50): 145 rps" and show dataset/workload on hover.
Marco: For pinning, show a snackbar "Version pinned" with undo; and include the pin status in user prefs so private deployments can sync.
Priya: Keyboard: make the header toggle focusable and add a skip link "Skip to compare tray". Checkboxes should announce selected state. Focus order: header -> filters -> list -> compare tray.
Vik: On mobile, use a sticky compare bar with count and CTA. That prevents needing a separate modal.
A11yBot: Also check colorblind palette for badges and ensure focus ring is visible (3px) across themes.
Nila: Decisions: 1) support cards + table with persistent per-user toggle, 2) rail (desktop) + modal (mobile) for filters + header chips, 3) pin affordance = bigger tap target + overflow action + left checkbox for multi-select + undo snackbar, 4) badge copy explicit + contrast + aria-labels, 5) keyboard flow and skip-link, 6) mobile sticky compare bar.
Marco: I'll add a small Figma update. Priya, can you add the a11y checklist to the ticket?
Priya: On it, will include tests & ARIA examples. :white_check_mark:
Nila: Thanks — will convert these to a short PRD and tag eng for API for /users/:id/preferences.
